   - config_002 (concat, singleprofile): 0.532
   - config_051 (weighted, singleprofile): 0.537
   - config_016 (weighted, singleprofile, resnet50): 0.540
   - In multiprofile: config_028 (weighted): 0.678, config_045 (weighted): 0.713
   - We don't have a direct concat vs weighted comparison in multiprofile with the same other settings.

   - config_002 (multimodal, singleprofile, scvi_n200, imagenet_vit_l): 0.532
